local G = (getfenv and getfenv(1)) or _ENV or _G
local unpack = table.unpack or unpack
local select, error = select, error
local function pack(...) return { n = select("#", ...), ... } end

local function MK(f, U)
  return function(...) return f(U, ...) end
end

local function CALL(R, A, B, C, top)
  local f = R[A]
  local n = (B == 0) and (top - A - 1) or (B - 1)
  local args = {}
  for i = 1, n do args[i] = R[A + i] end
  local res = pack(f(unpack(args, 1, n)))
  if C == 0 then
    for i = 1, res.n do R[A + i - 1] = res[i] end
    return A + res.n
  end
  for i = 1, C - 1 do R[A + i - 1] = res[i] end
  return top
end

local function RET(R, A, B, top)
  local n = (B == 0) and (top - A) or (B - 1)
  local t = {}
  for i = 1, n do t[i] = R[A + i - 1] end
  return unpack(t, 1, n)
end

local function SETLIST(R, A, B, C, top)
  local t = R[A]
  local n = (B == 0) and (top - A - 1) or B
  for i = 1, n do t[C + i] = R[A + i] end
end

local function VARARG(R, A, B, VA, NVA, top)
  if B == 0 then
    for i = 1, NVA do R[A + i - 1] = VA[i] end
    return A + NVA
  end
  for i = 1, B - 1 do R[A + i - 1] = VA and VA[i] or nil end
  return top
end

local function TFOR(R, A, B)
  local res = pack(R[A](R[A + 1], R[A + 2]))
  if res[1] ~= nil then
    R[A + 2] = res[1]
    for i = 1, B do R[A + 3 + i - 1] = res[i] end
    return true
  end
  return false
end
